verdict: A real lead spike this week, but Google spend dropped sharply and needs attention.
narrative: You received 13 leads over the last 28 days at a cost of $117.67 per lead, with a notable surge in the final 7 days — 5 of those 6 recent leads arrived on a single day, so this reads as a spike rather than a sustained trend. At the same time, Google Ads spend fell 53% week over week, dropping to roughly $12/day on average over the last 3 days versus $41/day the prior 3 days, which means paid search coverage is thinner than it should be heading into heating season. Six items from your agreed plan remain unresolved — including the booking bot, the financing page, the Homer Glen branch, and the LSA heating re-enable — and those are being prioritized now. Heating campaigns on both Google and Meta are scheduled to go live October 1st, and resolving the outstanding milestones will directly support that ramp.

watch_item.fix: Spend pacing is being corrected and heating campaigns are scheduled to go live October 1st to restore and expand coverage.
